title: Add Taste and Tales themed images to About section

requirements.text: Add four custom images to the 'What Makes Us Special' section in AboutPage.tsx, one for each value card (Global Culinary Journey, Premium Quality Ingredients, Hygiene & Safety First, Family-Friendly Ambiance), with visual elements that incorporate the Taste and Tales brand identity

quotes: in About section add images having indication of Taste and Tales of each part of "What makes us special" so that customer finds it attractive

acceptanceCriteria: Each of the four value cards displays a unique, branded image above or beside the text content
Images visually represent their respective value proposition while incorporating Taste and Tales brand elements
Images are rendered from frontend/public/assets/generated as static assets
Layout remains responsive and attractive on all screen sizes

constraints: Do not modify the core text content of the four value propositions
Maintain the existing responsive grid layout structure
nonGoals: Changing the About page's story section or brand heritage content
Modifying other pages or sections outside the About page
Adding animations or interactive elements to the images

required: Illustration of diverse global dishes and cultural food elements representing worldwide cuisines with Taste and Tales branding (global-culinary-journey.dim_400x300.png)
Fresh premium ingredients composition with quality indicators and Taste and Tales visual identity (premium-ingredients.dim_400x300.png)
Clean, professional kitchen environment with hygiene symbols and Taste and Tales brand elements (hygiene-safety.dim_400x300.png)
Warm family dining scene with welcoming atmosphere incorporating Taste and Tales brand motifs (family-friendly.dim_400x300.png)
